description: IAEW Ausbauheuristik is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by Institute for High Voltage Equipment and Grids; Digitalization and Energy Economics (IAEW); RWTH Aachen University. The heuristic can be used to creates and evaluate a very large number of potential expansion measures and is based on genetic algorithms. In addition to grid expansion measures, it can also be used to determine the optimal locations of flexibilities, e.g. hydrogen power plants and electrolysers that serve the power grid. Coverage: not restricted to one place on the factsheet. Methodical focus: Congestion Management, Expansion Planning, Regionalisation. Time resolution: hour. Spatial resolution: continents, national states, TSO regions, federal states. Software: MATLAB. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
